title: Grasim: standalone profit jumps, group in loss

timeline.title: Grasim: standalone profit jumps, group in loss
timeline.line: Standalone profit rose 186.5% to ₹2,306 crore; consolidated net loss was ₹234 crore
more: Standalone profit was lifted by ₹3,968 crore of dividend income from UltraTech
The consolidated loss includes a ₹767 crore charge tied to its Canada pulp venture
